notes.key_messages: To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should: • read all rubrics, texts and questions very carefully • ensure that any changed answers are clear and unambiguous • write answers to questions in French that are brief and coherent.
notes.general_comments: Candidates appeared to have sufficient time to complete the paper, and almost all candidates were appropriately entered for the examination. There were few instances of candidates leaving some questions blank.
